description.en: Adds a Robots page to the sidebar. A robot is a directory the plugin creates under ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots and mounts as a DSH workspace; only robots created here are managed. For each robot you can install project-level skills through npx skills, edit its AGENTS.md, open its conversation, or re-mount it after the workspace was removed.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏新增「机器人」页面。机器人是本插件在 ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots 下创建并挂载成 DSH 工作区的目录，只有这里创建的机器人才归插件管理。每个机器人可以用 npx skills 安装项目级 skills、编辑自己的 AGENTS.md、一键打开会话；工作区被删掉后还能重新挂载。
